The implementation is maintained in three modules under `eivGP/R/`: `helpers.R`, `mcmc.R` and `plotting.R`. Ocean uses these same modules. Install this checkout before running analyses.

See [installation and development](README.md) and the
[paper reproduction guide](paper/README.md).
